Measures elapsed days since prior customer order. High elapsed recency combined with unexpected order size signals dormant customer churn risk or erratic spot-purchasing.
Indicator for rejected or cancelled sales orders (ABSTK = C/X). High-value orders rejected by sales managers directly identify distressed or non-compliant customer transactions.
Frequency density of the dispatching manufacturing plant / depot. Deviations from standard supply plants flag cross-regional logistics and supply allocation anomalies.
Product division frequency. Captures concentration across Grey Cement, White Cement, Wall Putty, and specialty building products.
Total shipment physical weight in kilograms. Discrepancies between order value and weight identify price/density mispricing or haulage overload anomalies.
Operational density of the regional sales office. Flags anomalous dispatch locations or atypical sales branch transactions.
Average net price per unit across order line items. Unusually high or low unit pricing indicates incorrect discount condition records or manual price overrides.
Logarithmic compression of unit price ensuring robust outlier distance measurement without distortion from ultra-premium items.
Total historical order volume per customer. Distinguishes regular institutional accounts from low-frequency retail buyers.
